name: Product cutout shuffle
description: Turn a static catalog into a short SKU/flavor ad. Builds an editable 8-second vertical ad from your images, logo and copy. AI can suggest options from a website to fill the fields with its copy and images. No generated video.
tagline: You have aligned product cutouts and want viewers to distinguish variants.

props.subtitle: A 5-scene vertical ad, 8 seconds long. You supply images and short lines of copy. The app builds an editable cut, not a generated video.

props.text: Lays out every frame and finishes the cut. Pick one that reads images. Saved for next time.
Optional. Paints backgrounds and decoration for the layout. Saved for next time.

props.label: How do you want to start?

options.title: Fill from a website
options.description: Paste a product page. AI suggests the copy and images.

props.label: Website
props.hint: The agent reads the page with the finishing model and suggests three filled versions, with real images from the site. Pick one, then check each step.

props.text: No site at hand? Try this one.

props.label: Agent
props.placeholder: The agent's reading and image searches appear here.

props.subtitle: The pack that opens the ad at full size, and the line for it.

props.text: A pack cutout on a plain or transparent background.

props.label: Opening line
props.hint: Shows with the hero pack at full size.

props.label: Hero pack line
props.hint: Names what makes this pack different.

props.subtitle: Two more packs replace the hero at the same spot. They share one line.

props.label: Range benefit
props.hint: Shows when all three packs stand in a row.

props.subtitle: The whole range holds next to the call to action.

props.label: Layout agent
props.placeholder: The agent's layout edits and frame reviews appear here.

props.title: The layout needs a look
props.text: Edit the cut or plan again. You can still approve it.

value.title: Product cutout shuffle
value.objective: Turn a static catalog into a short SKU/flavor ad.
value.direction: The product occupies a fixed visual anchor; surrounding color and supporting cutouts change.
beats: 0–1 s: Hero pack is visible at full useful size. Shows Brand color, Hero pack, Opening line.
1–3 s: Product and two ingredient accents make one compact group. Shows Brand color, Hero pack, Hero pack line.
3–5 s: Replace with second and third packs at the same anchor. Shows Brand color, Pack 2, Pack 3, Line for packs 2 and 3.
5–6.5 s: All packs form a simple row or shallow fan. Shows Brand color, Hero pack, Pack 2, Pack 3, Range benefit.
6.5–8 s: Hold range plus CTA. Shows Brand color, Hero pack, Pack 2, Pack 3, Logo, Call to action.

images.label: Hero pack
images.guidance: A shot of the product alone, ideally on a plain or transparent background, so it reads as a cutout. Shown in: Hero pack is visible at full useful size. | Product and two ingredient accents make one compact group. | All packs form a simple row or shallow fan. | Hold range plus CTA.

images.label: Pack 2
images.guidance: A shot of the product alone, ideally on a plain or transparent background, so it reads as a cutout. Shown in: Replace with second and third packs at the same anchor. | All packs form a simple row or shallow fan. | Hold range plus CTA.

images.label: Pack 3
images.guidance: A shot of the product alone, ideally on a plain or transparent background, so it reads as a cutout. Shown in: Replace with second and third packs at the same anchor. | All packs form a simple row or shallow fan. | Hold range plus CTA.

images.label: Logo
images.guidance: The brand's own logo file, such as the site header logo or its icon. Shown in: Hold range plus CTA.
